faq.q: Which schools are near Arista, by name and address?

faq.q: How big can a secondary suite be in Surrey?
faq.a: No more than 40% of the habitable floor area of the principal dwelling unit, one suite per dwelling unit, and never inside a coach house or garden suite

faq.q: What should a buyer review before buying at Arista?
faq.a: The Form B information certificate, strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report, plus what the monthly fees include
